title: Before You Were Born
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler who goes anyway with shaking hands, and tonight Jeremiah, who felt far too small and too young, is told to go where he is sent because the Lord is with him.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because it takes courage to trust you are enough when you feel very small. In Beau's world today: Beau is the smallest one in his class, and today it was his turn to hold the heavy door. His hands shook a little. He held it anyway, and every friend walked through. Just like Jeremiah, who was young and went anyway, Beau learned that Heavenly Father sends small people to do good things.
